Oneliner

Remote sensing mission using GNSS-R for measurement of the soil moisture across the globe.
Description

Remote sensing mission using Global Navigation Satellite System Reflectometry (GNSS-R) for measurement of the soil moisture across the globe. GNSS-R is a method of sensing the Earth’s surface by measuring reflected signals transmitted by navigation satellites.
